about_the_game:
FIND EDEN
...a story-rich experience

Play as Timmy, a young being whose fears and dreams come to life in a surreal, monochromatic world. When a mysterious creature lures him into the night, Timmy finds himself in a strange, eerie realm overrun by monsters and inhabited by enigmatic cats. Explore a haunting landscape and uncover the secrets of this shadowy world.

MEET THE MAIN CHARACTER

Timmy is a simple creature. You control him and the more you play, the more you learn about his personality, what he likes, what makes him laugh, what scares him and...what his darkest desires are.

Indirectly you will find clues about the world of 'Find Eden', its characters and the mystery that veiled this fantastic world. 

MEET CATS IN THEIR OWN REALM

In this demo version, experience the beginning of Timmy's journey: from the warmth of his colorful, foreshadowing home to the chilling moment he steps into a realm where danger and mystery lurk around every corner. With expressive white eyes as your guide, navigate through hand-drawn environments, avoid terrifying creatures, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth.

MAIN GAME FEATURES

  • Hand-drawn visuals: A striking black aesthetic with vibrant, detailed highlights.

  • Atmospheric storytelling: Dive into Timmy's fears, memories, and the mysteries of a world beyond his own.

  • Puzzle-platforming gameplay: Explore, solve, and survive in a dark, interconnected world.

  • Emotional depth: A tale of courage, loss, and unexpected alliances.

Will you help Timmy face his darkest fears and uncover the truth behind this strange realm? The journey begins here...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or dedicated GPU with at least 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No VR Support
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and Mouse needed
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (or newer) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with at least 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No VR Support
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and Mouse

short_description: Step into Timmy's Dark Descent, a 2D Dark Fantasy Platformer with stunning hand-drawn artistry. In this demo, guide Timmy through puzzles, explore his home, and face a mysterious realm where monsters lurk—and cats may become unlikely allies. Will you uncover the truth? The journey begins here...
